meta.title: 停止将能力问题道德化.mp4

material.title_suggested: 停止将能力问题道德化.mp4
material.advice: 材料中长句较多，如第2、4、10块，建议先按意群拆分再连读；注意第10块有并列结构（缺乏体力、心理能量、安全感），可用关键词串联记忆；第11块有口误“到的话”，背诵时按原文保留即可。

chunks.text: 变强的第一要物呢,就是停止将能力问题道德化 道德化是大脑中的一种快捷方式
chunks.translation: The first essential for becoming stronger is to stop moralizing ability issues. Moralizing is a shortcut in the brain.

chunks.text: 比如说,你被别人伤害了,你把它规戒为对方是个坏人 那这个比分析它为什么敢这样对待我 我以后该怎么设置边界要容易的多
chunks.translation: For example, if you are hurt by someone, you categorize them as a bad person. That is much easier than analyzing why they dared to treat me this way and how I should set boundaries in the future.

chunks.text: 这种道德化的处理会给你一种掌控感 用来填补这种内心的无力感 它还会给你提供一种在心理上的台阶
chunks.translation: This moralizing treatment gives you a sense of control to fill the inner feeling of powerlessness. It also provides you with a psychological step.

chunks.text: 比如说你在一次竞争中失败了 你没有分析自己到底是输在哪个环节 哪个环节可以优化 而是直接告诉自己自己不是这块料 那你就逃避了那个真正的成长的机会
chunks.translation: For example, if you fail in a competition, you don't analyze which stage you lost at and which stage could be optimized, but directly tell yourself that you are not cut out for it. Then you escape the real opportunity for growth.

chunks.text: 当这种习惯化的一种道德化,一种标签化的处理 其实也不完全怪我们自己 它是一种从小到大被训练出来的一种思维方式
chunks.translation: When this habitual moralizing and labeling treatment happens, it's not entirely our fault. It is a way of thinking trained into us from childhood.

chunks.text: 从小我们就被像努力,像忍耐,像听话这种 道德的标词所衡量 所以长大之后我们也会用 同样的这一套齿子去衡量整个世界 包括衡量自己
chunks.translation: From childhood, we are measured by moral labels like hard work, endurance, and obedience. So when we grow up, we also use the same set of standards to measure the whole world, including ourselves.

chunks.text: 所以我们如果想让自己真正的变强,想让自己真正的成长 我们首先要识别这些阻碍成长的思维的架索 然后有意识的去调整这些思维方式
chunks.translation: So if we want to truly become stronger and truly grow, we first need to identify these thought shackles that hinder growth, and then consciously adjust these ways of thinking.

chunks.text: 不要这种快捷方式,这种标签化的处理方式 我们要把生活中遇到的困难当做技术问题来处理 而不是道德问题来处理
chunks.translation: Don't use this shortcut, this labeling treatment. We should treat the difficulties we encounter in life as technical problems to solve, not as moral problems.

chunks.text: 比如说拖延其实并不是一个无要可救的一个性格弱点 而是你没有设置好一个能让自己顺常启动的一个生活系统
chunks.translation: For example, procrastination is not an incurable character weakness, but rather that you haven't set up a life system that allows you to start smoothly.

chunks.text: 包括懒惰罔网友不是说你的品形问题 可能是源于你的能量管理问题 在缺乏体力 缺乏心理能量 在缺乏安全感的时候 人就会本能地进行这种低频的运转 这才是你应该去面对的问题
chunks.translation: Including laziness and addiction to the internet is not a problem of your character, but may stem from your energy management problem. When lacking physical strength, lacking mental energy, and lacking a sense of security, people will instinctively operate at this low frequency. This is the problem you should face.

chunks.text: 所以停止将能力问题到的话 真正的意义在于 把审判自己的这种负面的能量转移到提升自我 提升能力,解决问题上面
chunks.translation: So the real significance of stopping moralizing ability issues lies in transferring the negative energy of judging yourself to improving yourself, enhancing your abilities, and solving problems.

chunks.text: 当一个人不再视自己为问题 而是能够把问题剥离出来重新看待的时候 改变的动力就会从内心升起
chunks.translation: When a person no longer sees themselves as the problem, but can separate the problem and look at it anew, the motivation for change will rise from within.

chunks.text: 而一味的用我应该努力 我应该有责任感去要求自己 往往得到的不是动力 而是更深的自我攻击
chunks.translation: But blindly demanding yourself with 'I should work hard' and 'I should have a sense of responsibility' often results not in motivation, but in deeper self-attack.
